astranl.cost_or_fee_if_any: 0 to read, verify or ask; 1 percent of the transaction only when AstraNL coordinated a completed paid task; nothing else, ever
astranl.do_not_use_when: you need a quote, a booking, a web search, or proof about a specific AstraNL task
astranl.example_intent: Current Dutch public tenders for ventilation cleaning, with sources and closing dates
astranl.next_possible_action: fetch a record id for detail; ask_astranl to turn a need into a task
astranl.proof_level: source-attributed records with observation time; not signed
required_inputs: optional source: auto, materials, public_tenders, protocol_identity, all
astranl.returns: records with update times and fresh/stale/unknown labels, disagreements, coverage gaps, ready context_text; a cached price is not a quote
astranl.use_when: you want source-linked real-world context for an answer: Dutch public tenders, building material products and prices, or AstraNL protocol identity

description: Get compact, source-linked real-world context for an LLM in ONE read-only call. Searches AstraNL public materials or tender records, or its protocol identity. Use source=public_tenders for tenders, materials for products; auto keeps domains separate. Returns record update times, fresh/stale/unknown labels, record disagreements, coverage gaps and ready-to-use context_text. Never books, contacts or pays anyone. Not a general web search: no match is not proof of absence; a cached price is not a quote. Optional astranl.reality-link.v2 profile checks exact source-record claims. It does not promote registry records to independently verified real-world facts. official.deadline on tender:TED-* records is checked live at the EU publisher (TED), budgeted and cached; unavailable means UNKNOWN.

claims.description: v2 only. Each claim names a record id from a previous result, a predicate and the expected value.

max_items.description: v1 only; v2 looks up at most 12 records and refuses max_items.

protocol.description: Omit for the v1 context call. Set to astranl.reality-link.v2 together with claims to check typed claims against source records.

query.description: Short subject, product keywords or identifier; all product keyword groups must match.

source.description: v1: auto, materials, public_tenders, protocol_identity or all. v2 requires an explicit materials, public_tenders or protocol_identity.

name: ground_astranl
